g.text: A balanced delta shares line voltage and combines phase currents at each corner

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Delta phase-current references are a→b, b→c, c→a. The −30° relation applies to balanced abc phase currents; it is not a general unbalanced identity.
Equivalent balanced wye preserves external line voltages/currents. Example 12 Ω delta corresponds to 4 Ω wye.
